title: Finite Q3 cancellation-aware signed union-commutator audit
question: When the first-order Lie-Trotter commutator defect is grouped by exact union support and its signs are retained, do finite Q3 cancellations produce a cutoff-, beta-, volume- and source-uniform state-weighted coefficient?

named_proxy.core: finite oscillator matrix proxy on each exact union U of overlapping Q3 term supports
named_proxy.signed_group: S_U=sum of [H_j,H_k] with the declared term-order sign for all pairs whose exact union is U
named_proxy.reverse_order: the explicit reverse term order, checked against -S_U rather than silently identified
named_proxy.state: rho_U=exp(-beta H_U)/Tr(exp(-beta H_U)) for the induced local Hamiltonian
named_proxy.energy: K_U=I+H_U-min(spec(H_U)) I and four-leg K_U^(1/2)-Gibbs seminorm
named_proxy.coefficient: sum over U of the signed-group seminorms; all-union and source-touching aggregates are both reported

adversarial_review.check: Signs are retained only within an exact union-support group; the result is not relabelled as the absolute pair-sum bound used by EXP-001162.
The reverse term order is explicitly rebuilt and its group matrix is compared with the negative forward group matrix.
rho_U is an induced finite union Gibbs matrix and is not identified with a restriction of an infinite-volume KMS state.
The four K_U^(1/2)-Gibbs legs are computed separately for every signed group; no spectral commutation is assumed.
Every volume, cutoff and beta row rebuilds all matrices and spectral factors; finite growth ratios are not asymptotic bounds.
Only the declared source supports and exact union groups are aggregated; boundary-dependent counts are retained.
Signed finite cancellations do not prove a common unbounded core, global-state transfer, thermodynamic history, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

lean_crosscheck.role: R335 checks exact rational signed-pair cancellation, reverse-order antisymmetry and proxy coefficient bookkeeping; matrix spectra, domains and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: A finite union-support signed-defect table with explicit reverse-order antisymmetry and local Gibbs/energy-weighted diagnostics across the declared grid.
qft_interface.open: A global-state-compatible cancellation estimate, cutoff/volume/beta-uniform coefficient, common core, actual Trotter defect theorem, thermodynamic history, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 evidence only; no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

next_action: Compare the signed-group coefficient with EXP-001164 and attempt an analytic cancellation-aware D,delta-D estimate on the matching-layer common core; if the group coefficient still grows, retain the route-local boundary and do not promote common alpha.
no_overclaim: This is a finite cancellation-aware local-state proxy audit. It does not prove a global KMS state, common unbounded core, thermodynamic QFT dynamics, a mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a Clay result.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite signed union-commutator diagnostic only.
